description: This Java source file defines the main Spring Boot application class for a project named 'ModernRepo.' It includes application startup logic to verify PostgreSQL database connectivity, logs JDBC configuration details with obfuscation for security, and performs connection retries in case of specific protocol or SSL errors. It also contains annotations to enable JPA auditing and serves as the entry point for the application.
